module: Flowgraph node "Rally Advance Loop Schedule" (category once_instant, tag rally, no pin). Asks the rally loop manager (gameplay_rallyLoop.getManager()) to move to the next mission in the schedule via rm:getNextMissionId(), and logs the result (D if a next mission exists, W otherwise, E if the manager cannot be found or the extension is not loaded).

workOnce.desc: Calls rm:getNextMissionId() (which advances the schedule) and logs the id obtained.
